5) La nescience est à traiter comme une maladie.
1119
Tad asya mahato duḥkha-samudāyasya prabhava-bījam avidyā / Tasyāś ca samyag-darśanam
abhāva-hetuḥ / Yathā cikitsā-śāstraṃ catur-vyūham : rogo roga-hetur ārogyaṃ bhaiṣajyam
iti, evam idam api śāstraṃ catur-vyūham eva / Tad yathā saṃsāraḥ saṃsāra-hetur mokṣo
mokṣa-upāya iti / Tatra duḥkha-bahulaḥ saṃsāro heyaḥ / Pradhāna-puruṣayoḥ saṃyogo heya-
hetuḥ / Saṃyogasya–ātyantikī nivṛttir hānam / Hāna-upāyaḥ samyag-darśanam / Tatra hātuḥ
svarūpam upādeyaṃ vā heyaṃ
